title: FlowDoc First Delivery Round

expectedOutput: Project Control records the First Delivery Round Plan with Lane Cards, WORK room Kickoff Packets, owner repository boundaries, terminology decisions, stop conditions, evidence targets, accepted Core boundary evidence, accepted Backend pre-admission smoke evidence, automatic WORK-to-PLAN return status, and next dispatch recommendations before dependent WORK lanes continue.
